item.title: Sobriety checkpoints planed across the state in the month of March
item.description: The South Dakota Highway Patrol will hold sobriety checkpoints in 14 counties throughout the month of March. Checkpoints are planned for Beadle, Brookings, Brown, Clay, Codington, Day, Hughes, Hutchinson, Jones, Lawrence, Lincoln, Meade, Minnehaha, and Pennington counties.
